Travel & birding · Jamaica

Jamaica

November 18–25, 2023

Overview — Daily Itinerary — Places to Stay — Vlogs

Overview

A Thanksgiving holiday trip to Jamaica. We drove around the island, with stops at Montego Bay, Negril, Kingston, Ocho Rios and Falmouth. Google Map Itinerary.

We saw 21 of the 28 endemic bird species on the island.

eBird trip report.

Daily Itinerary

Sat, November 18 — Arrival in Montego Bay

  • Flights: WN 621 and WN 292, arriving at 2:50pm
  • Hertz car rental

Stay: Hotel Grand A View, Montego Bay

Sun, November 19 — Montego Bay to Negril

  • Rocklands Bird Sanctuary
    • Highlights include Red-billed Streamertail, Jamaican Mango, etc.
  • Half Moon Beach
  • Drive to Negril (2 hr)

Stay: The Cliff Hotel Jamaica, Negril

Mon, November 20 — Horse Riding & Rick's Cafe

  • 8:30am: Horse Riding Tour
  • Dinner at Rick's Cafe

Stay: The Cliff Hotel Jamaica, Negril

Tue, November 21 — Negril to Kingston

  • Floyd's Pelican Bar
    • A very cool floating restaurant on the sea
    • Drive to Parottee and take a boat
    • Call 876-809-4239 for a boat upon arrival
    • No restroom available
  • Drive to Kingston (4 hr)

Stay: ROK Hotel Kingston, Kingston

Wed, November 22 — Birding Tour in Kingston

  • Birding Tour with Arrowhead Birding Tours
    • Led by Ricardo Miller, the #1 birder in Jamaica on eBird
    • We started at 4:30am before sunrise to search for Jamaican Owl first.
    • We spent the morning at Hardwar Gap in Blue Mountain NP searching for the endemics.
    • We went to Hope Botanical Gardens after lunch.
    • We saw most of the Jamaican endemic birds during the tour. Highly recommended!

Stay: ROK Hotel Kingston, Kingston

Thu, November 23 — Bob Marley Tour

  • 10:00am–11:30am: Bob Marley Home Tour
    • 56 Hope Road, Kingston, Jamaica
  • Drive to Ocho Rios (1.5 hr)

Stay: Sago Palm Hotel, Ocho Rios

Fri, November 24 — Rafting, caves & luminous lagoon

  • White River Rafting
  • Drive to Falmouth (1.5 hr)
  • Green Grotto Cave
  • 6:30pm: Glistening Waters at Glistening Waters Luminous Lagoon Hotel & Attraction

Stay: The Vista Inn, Falmouth

Sat, November 25 — Rose Hall & Departure

  • Rose Hall Great House
  • 2:15pm: Departure on WN 273, connecting to WN 2697

Places to Stay

  • November 18: Hotel Grand A View, 3 Ramparts Close, Montego Bay, St James, Jamaica
  • November 19–20: The Cliff Hotel Jamaica, W End Rd, Negril, Jamaica
  • November 21–22: ROK Hotel Kingston, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, 2–4 King Street, Kingston, JMAKN02, Jamaica
  • November 23: Sago Palm Hotel, 54 Main St, Ocho Rios, Jamaica
  • November 24: The Vista Inn, Stonebrook Vista, Lot 345 Pearl Avenue, Falmouth, Jamaica
